summary.text: Kyle Hall is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 91 since November 23, 2015, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Hall as chair of the Appropriations Committee and the House Redistricting Committee, vice chair of the Appropriations on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources and Appropriations on Information Technology committees, and a member of the Agriculture, Commerce, Environment, Insurance, and Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House committees.
Ballotpedia reports that his 2016 campaign website listed improving education among the issues he highlighted.
